name: Is it better to repair or replace a large section of textured drywall?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace a large section of textured drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace a large section of textured drywall depends on the extent and type of damage. Repair is often suitable for localized damage, even if extensive in area, provided the underlying structure is sound. Replacement is usually necessary if there's significant structural damage, widespread water damage, or extensive mold growth that cannot be fully remediated. A contractor can assess the situation to recommend the most cost-effective and durable solution for your specific issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair large textured drywall sections if damage is localized and structure is sound. Replace for extensive structural damage, widespread water damage, or significant mold.
